title: Messaging providers
description: Configure SMS and WhatsApp providers for this company. Only active providers are used for outbound messages.

help.title: About Messaging providers
help.overview: Messaging providers deliver this company's SMS and WhatsApp messages. Twilio is currently the supported provider, and new providers start active.

sections.title: Configuration
items: Name, account SID, and auth token are required. SMS sender and WhatsApp sender numbers are optional.
Use Test connection to verify the credentials and provider access.

sections.title: Sending and deletion
items: Only active providers are used for outgoing SMS and WhatsApp messages.
Deleting a provider is a soft delete and it can be restored.
